difficulty_reason: With (*) the property that TF(B, -) turns short exact sequences of B-modules into right exact sequences, the lemma asserts permanence of (*) on the quotient of a short exact sequence when it holds for the first two terms, on the middle term when it holds for the outer two, and on the fibre product G x_H H' when it holds for all four (statement lines 1358-1372). The proof gives each part its own displayed three-by-three diagram with the exact rows and the exact columns that are being assumed, and reads the required exactness off by a chase; the third part is reduced to the second through the exact sequence 0 -> F -> G x_H H' -> H' -> 0 (proof lines 1375-1417). The level is H3: the diagrams are large, the exactness data in each is specified, and the reduction of (3) to (2) is stated with its exact sequence.
